reportedIssues: The promo badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' reads '-0%', which advertises a zero-percent discount — almost certainly a data/formatting bug where a missing or zero discount value is still rendered as a badge.

The favorite (heart) button on the second popular card uses a dark/translucent circular background while the identical control on the first card uses a solid white background, creating an inconsistent look and reduced icon contrast on the busy pizza image.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' carousel has a very light, near-white background while sibling thumbnails are dark, making the white '15–25 min' badge harder to read and the card look washed out compared to its neighbours.

expected.reasoning: Issue 0 directly describes the discount badge showing '-0%' on a pizza card, matching the expected defect exactly.
